title: Blame
description: The commit that last changed each line of a file, up to the review commit.

ignoreRevsFile.description: The commits that .git-blame-ignore-revs at the review commit names were ignored.

ranges.description: Ascending and without gaps, from line 1 to the last line. Adjacent lines of one commit form one range.

commits.description: Each commit of ranges once, in the order of its first range.

contributors.description: Each author of commits once, in the order of the first commit of the author. One author is one email, compared in lower case, or one name of a commit without an email.

authorName.description: As the commit records it, without a mailmap.

summary.description: The first line of the commit message.

contributorIndex.description: The index of the author of the commit in contributors.

htmlUrl.description: The commit on github.com for a GitHub repository. Null for a local repository.

name.description: The author name of the first commit of the author.

avatarUrl.description: The GitHub avatar of an author with a GitHub account, for a repository without a server copy. Else a generated identicon as an SVG data URI, the same for one author in each answer. The answer holds no email.
